sloka: प्रपन्नो दीर्घमध्वानं राजन्नद्यासि दुर्गमम् ।नय मामपि दुःखार्तां न जीविष्ये त्वया विना ।। ६.११४.६० ।।
transliteration: prapanno dīrghamadhvānaṁ rājannadyāsi durgamam ।naya māmapi duḥkhārtāṁ na jīviṣye tvayā vinā ।। 6.114.60 ।।

translations.english: "Disconnected with relatives, forsaken by you also, deprived of sensual pleasures, I shall grieve permanently."
